mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary_media (id, diary_id, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{diaryId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, diary_id, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, created_at, is_deleted, deleted_at FROM diary_media WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT id, diary_id, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, created_at, is_deleted, deleted_at FROM diary_media WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE diary_media SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE diary_media SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} AND is_deleted = 0
